title: [tool_crash] Unhandled SessionNotCreatedException in WebDriverService.startTest during flutter drive
body:
### Summary
In Flutter 3.47.5 (7 days post-release), `SessionNotCreatedException` at `parseW3cResponse` (`package:webdriver/src/handler/w3c/utils.dart-9abe6b17`) is the #6 tool crasher, accounting for **112 crashes (7.3% of Top 10 crashes, 3.7% of all crashes)** during `flutter drive`.

### Stack Trace & Error Message
```text
SessionNotCreatedException (500): session not created: DevToolsActivePort file doesn't exist
```
*(Also observed with Safari WebDriver timeouts: `SessionNotCreatedException (500): Could not create a session: The session timed out while connecting to a Safari instance.`)*

```text
#0      parseW3cResponse (package:webdriver/src/handler/w3c/utils.dart:81)
#1      W3cSessionHandler.parseCreateResponse (package:webdriver/src/handler/w3c/session.dart:19)
#2      InferSessionHandler.parseCreateResponse (package:webdriver/src/handler/infer_handler.dart:106)
#3      AsyncRequestClient.send (package:webdriver/src/common/request_client.dart:96)
<asynchronous suspension>
#4      createDriver (package:webdriver/async_core.dart:62)
<asynchronous suspension>
#5      WebDriverService.startTest (package:flutter_tools/src/drive/web_driver_service.dart:200)
<asynchronous suspension>
#6      DriveCommand.runCommand (package:flutter_tools/src/commands/drive.dart:387)
```

### Root Cause Analysis
In `WebDriverService.startTest` (`packages/flutter_tools/lib/src/drive/web_driver_service.dart:199-219`), `async_io.createDriver(...)` only catches `SocketException`:
```dart
    try {
      webDriver = await async_io.createDriver(
        uri: Uri.parse('http://localhost:$driverPort/'),
        desired: getDesiredCapabilities(...),
      );
    } on SocketException catch (error) {
      _logger.printTrace('$error');
      throwToolExit(
        'Unable to start a WebDriver session for web testing.\n'
        'Make sure you have the correct WebDriver server (e.g. chromedriver) running at $driverPort.\n'
        'For instructions on how to obtain and run a WebDriver server, see:\n'
        'https://flutter.dev/to/integration-test-on-web\n',
      );
    }
```
When the WebDriver server (`chromedriver`, `safaridriver`, `geckodriver`) is reachable over TCP but fails to launch or connect to the browser instance (e.g., Chrome crashes on launch without `--no-sandbox` / `DevToolsActivePort file doesn't exist`, browser/driver version mismatch, or Safari automation session timeout), `package:webdriver` throws `WebDriverException` (`SessionNotCreatedException`), which escapes uncaught as a tool crash.

### Expected Behavior
`WebDriverService.startTest` should catch `async_io.WebDriverException` (or `SessionNotCreatedException`) and call `throwToolExit` with the underlying WebDriver error message rather than crashing `flutter_tools`.

### Related Issues & PRs
- Prior closed/locked issues: https://github.com/flutter/flutter/issues/185032, https://github.com/flutter/flutter/issues/183363, https://github.com/flutter/flutter/issues/177981, https://github.com/flutter/flutter/issues/174195, https://github.com/flutter/flutter/issues/169006, https://github.com/flutter/flutter/issues/163790
